title: Welcome to Modular
markdown:
This dashboard starts empty on purpose.

Use a guided tutorial to learn the core workflow before building your own board.

You can reopen any tutorial later from the **Tutorials** menu.

actions.label: Dashboard Basics
actions.description: Learn panes, datasources, widgets, and a first time plot.

actions.label: XY Signal Generator
actions.description: Trace two signal generators against each other in a live XY plot.

actions.label: Fast Frame From CSV
actions.description: Load a captured CSV waveform and plot a math channel on a Fast Frame widget.

actions.label: FFT Spectrum From CSV
actions.description: Load a captured CSV waveform and analyse its frequency content with FFT.

actions.label: Vertical Gauge Basics
actions.description: Add a live gauge widget, bind it to a signal generator, and explore the runtime offset control.
